violatedPolicies.name: Latest tag
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with images using tag 'latest'
violatedPolicies.remediation: Consider moving to semantic versioning based on code releases (semver.org) or using the first 12 characters of the source control SHA. This will allow you to tie the Docker image to the code.

violatedPolicies.name: Red Hat Package Manager in Image
violatedPolicies.description: Alert on deployments with components of the Red Hat/Fedora/CentOS package management system.
violatedPolicies.remediation: Run `rpm -e --nodeps $(rpm -qa '*rpm*' '*dnf*' '*libsolv*' '*hawkey*' 'yum*')` in the image build for production containers.
